about.title: About Zora
about.intro: Zora started from a simple idea: days get better when the things around us have a story, color and a bit of light.

sections.p: Every Zora illustration is original and made for our catalog. We don’t use stock images or reproduce anyone else’s art. Each collection — from pets to city skylines — starts with a theme and a lot of sketches.
We work with print partners who produce each piece after your order. That means no idle stock, less waste and no pieces nobody wanted.
Gamers, professionals who love what they do, plant people, cat people… Our collections are made so everyone finds something that feels like them.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: From the drawing board to your door, in four steps.

steps.p: Browse the collections, pick the art and the product, and customize color, size or frame. The mockup shows everything in real time.
After payment, your order goes straight to production. Customers can’t upload art: every illustration is exclusive to Zora.
A print partner produces your piece with high-definition printing. Production takes 2–5 business days.
As soon as your piece leaves production, we send the tracking code. You follow everything in your account.

how.note: This is a prototype: no order is actually produced or shipped.

shipping.title: Shipping & delivery
shipping.intro: We ship across Brazil and worldwide. The values below are examples used in this prototype.

sections.p: 2 to 5 business days, counted from payment confirmation.
Standard: R$ 19.90, 7–12 business days. Express: R$ 34.90, 3–5 business days. Free standard shipping on orders over R$ 299.
Standard: US$ 14.00, 10–18 business days. Express: US$ 29.00, 4–7 business days. Free standard shipping on orders over US$ 75. Import taxes may be charged by the destination country.
You get the tracking code by email and can also find it under My account > My orders.

returns.title: Returns & exchanges
returns.intro: Your satisfaction comes first. Here’s how it works.

sections.p: If your piece arrives damaged or different from your order, we send a new one at no cost. Just tell us within 30 days, with a photo.
Since each piece is made on demand, returns for change of mind follow consumer law: you have 7 days after delivery to cancel the purchase.
Write to us on the Contact page with your order number. We reply within 2 business days.

items.q: Can I upload my own image?
items.a: No. All art is original Zora work and we don’t accept customer images.
Production takes 2–5 business days, plus the shipping time you choose at checkout.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Credit card and Pix. (In this prototype payment is simulated and nothing is charged.)

items.q: How do I use a coupon?
items.a: Enter the code in your cart and click Apply. If the coupon has rules (minimum value, currency or expiry) we tell you why it can’t be used.

items.q: Can I change color or size after buying?
items.a: Since production starts right after payment, changes are only possible in the first hours. Get in touch via Contact.
Yes! Switch language and currency at the top of the page to see prices in dollars.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Sample text for the prototype. It has no legal value.

sections.p: Zora sells products with its own illustrations, produced on demand by partners. By using the site, you agree to these terms.
Prices are shown in the selected currency and may change without notice. An order is only confirmed after payment is approved.
All illustrations belong to Zora. Copying or reproducing the art without permission is prohibited.
We may update these terms at any time. The current version is always available on this page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Sample text for the prototype. It has no legal value.

sections.p: Name, email, address and order details, only to process your purchase and assist you. In this prototype, everything is stored only in your browser.
On a real site we’d use secure connections and certified payment providers. Card data never passes through our servers.
You can request access, correction or deletion of your data at any time via the Contact page.
We use browser storage to remember language, currency, cart and wishlist.
